exposure: Semi-automatic Robson Ten-Group Classification System classification
Manual Robson Ten-Group Classification System classification
outcome: Accuracy of Robson Ten-Group Classification System classification
cohort: 1370 deliveries in an obstetric unit in 2018
finding: A relevant proportion of errors were found in the semi-automatic classification of deliveries using the Robson Ten-Group Classification System, potentially influencing statistics related to cesarean section rates.
